bootstrap.ci: percentiles [2.5, 97.5] (numpy linear) over resamples where the metric is defined

definitions.agreement_with_v03_phase_a_network: argmax agreement between the v0.5 network and the v0.3 A network; 'all' = every gate-passing validation window (any oracle label), 'scored' = the scored population; no labels are used
definitions.ambiguous_predictions: class distribution of predictions on gate-passing INSUFFICIENT_AMBIGUOUS windows (reported, not scored)
definitions.bootstrap: sessions resampled with replacement (n of n); every metric recomputed from summed per-session counts; 95% CI = 2.5th/97.5th percentile (numpy linear) over resamples where the metric is defined
definitions.confusion_matrix: rows = oracle label, columns = predicted class, both in ClassLabel order (PRODUCTIVE, RECOVERY, STALLED, OSCILLATING); counts of scored windows
definitions.f1: 2PR / (P + R); 0 if P + R = 0; null if support is 0
definitions.false_alarm_rate: scored windows with oracle label PRODUCTIVE or RECOVERY predicted STALLED or OSCILLATING / scored windows with oracle label PRODUCTIVE or RECOVERY
definitions.gate_rejected: windows the runtime gate rejects; they have no input vector and receive no prediction; excluded from every metric
definitions.instrumentation_predictions: class distribution of predictions on gate-passing INSUFFICIENT_INSTRUMENTATION windows (gate/oracle disagreement; reported, not scored)
definitions.macro_f1: mean F1 over the canonical classes with support > 0 in the scored population
definitions.network: the v0.5 network's classes, scored exactly as v0.3 scored a network (eval.metrics, v0.3 windows, gate and populations)
definitions.paired_macro_f1: macro-F1(minuend) - macro-F1(subtrahend) over the shared session-bootstrap draws (overall, not per family), v04.scoring.paired_macro_f1
definitions.per_family_bootstrap: each family resamples its own sessions, seed = int.from_bytes(sha256(f'{seed}:family:{family}').digest()[:8], 'big')
definitions.precision: TP / windows predicted as the class; 0 if the class has support but is never predicted; null if it has neither
definitions.prior always-PRODUCTIVE: PRODUCTIVE on every gate-passing window (what an all-zero network predicts: argmax ties go to index 0)
definitions.recall: TP / support; null if support is 0
definitions.scored_population: windows that pass the runtime gate and carry a scored oracle label (PRODUCTIVE, RECOVERY, STALLED, OSCILLATING)
definitions.split: validation only; the scoring code refuses every other split before opening any file
definitions.v03_phase_a_network: the archived v0.3 Phase A network (weight_program/v0_3/phase-a/artifact.dlw) on the same windows and bootstrap draws; it fills the slot v0.3 gave the reference policy, which does not change the network block

network_latency.definition: time.process_time (all threads of the worker process) and perf_counter around one infer.eoe_logits call per session, in one of `workers` concurrent worker processes

network_logits.definition: EOE logits of every event of every val session (no labels): non-finite = any of the four logits is NaN/inf; tied top = two or more classes share the top logit (argmax takes the first); all equal = all four logits equal (e.g. an all-zero output)

populations.excluding_disclosed: every validation session except the 200 v0.3 Phase B disclosed sessions (v0.3 rule, checked against experiments/v0_3/DISCLOSURE_PRIVATE.json); primary, as in v0.3

scored: the network only (no reference policy in this arm)

v03_phase_a_logits.definition: EOE logits of every event of every val session (no labels): non-finite = any of the four logits is NaN/inf; tied top = two or more classes share the top logit (argmax takes the first); all equal = all four logits equal (e.g. an all-zero output)

visibility: harness only: never shown to a weight author (a v0.5 run gets no feedback)
